$comment: Temporary high/critical advisory allowlist read by the CI audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs).
An entry is ONLY justified when a fix exists but is currently un-installable under .npmrc
min-release-age=7 (the patched version is published but <7 days old). Each entry MUST be
converted to an npm `overrides` pin and DELETED from this file once its fix ages past
min-release-age (see `ageInOn`). The gate FAILS on ANY high/critical advisory NOT listed here,
so the allowlist never weakens the gate for un-triaged findings. Reviewed by the Architect.
STATUS 2026-06-18: empty. The three prior entries (form-data GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx, vite
GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff, undici GHSA-vmh5-mc38-953g) are now pinned to their patched versions via
`overrides` in package.json (form-data 4.0.6, vite 8.0.16, undici 7.28.0). npm audit reports 0
high/critical. The committed lockfile pins those versions, so `npm ci`/`npm install` install them
cleanly while .npmrc keeps min-release-age=7 for all other (future) dependency resolution.

allow.runtimePath: DEV/LINT-TIME ONLY. Sole remaining path is the hoisted minimatch@3.1.5 consumed by eslint@9.39.5 and 5 eslint plugins. Brace patterns come from eslint config files and tsconfig, never from an HTTP request body or other external input, so the DoS is not reachable. The two minimatch@10.2.5 paths (@typescript-eslint/typescript-estree, glob) are pinned to 5.0.8 and are NOT covered by this entry.
allow.reason: The fixed version 5.0.8 is structurally incompatible with this consumer: it exports { expand } with __esModule, while minimatch@3.1.5 calls the require() result as a function, producing 'expand is not a function' on any pattern containing braces. Verified by direct execution. Backports 1.1.17/1.1.18 exist (2026-07-29 / 2026-07-30) but are inside the advisory range per GHSA metadata and are blocked by min-release-age=7. REVIEW ON 2026-08-06: check whether 1.1.18 carries the fix and, if so, replace this entry with a pin.
